scenario.name: Public chatbot discovery baseline
scenario.objective: Discover a public chatbot interface and capture an observable response.
scenario.description: Provider-neutral discovery against a public ChatBot.com sample page.

inputs.value: What can you help me with?

scenario.expectedBehavior: The chat interface accepts the message and exposes an observable response.

finishConditions.description: A non-empty bot response is captured.

expectedIntent: Answer the user's support question using the chatbot's available knowledge.
